sandbox_2_gold.itemDesc: Unprocessed Pure Gold, low in value or circulation. Here, though, it is all that glitters! So keep them safe and secure!
sandbox_2_gold.obtainApproach: Chance to drop from combat; from Plans

sandbox_2_dimensioncoin.itemDesc: A rare, fragile metal obtained from ore veins, popular amongst the wealthy because of its shininess, and used as currency in some regions.

sandbox_2_wood.itemUsage: Basic construct material widely used in the construction of buildings.
sandbox_2_wood.itemDesc: Do not use as firewood without thoroughly drying it out, unless you want to cover half the sky in smoke.
sandbox_2_wood.obtainApproach: Obtain from gathering; purchased from shop

sandbox_2_stone.itemUsage: Common construct material widely used in the construction of buildings.
sandbox_2_stone.itemDesc: Be careful not to sprain your back when carrying it.
sandbox_2_stone.obtainApproach: Obtain from gathering; purchased from shop

sandbox_2_iron.itemUsage: High-strength construct material widely used in the construction of buildings.
sandbox_2_iron.itemDesc: Observe proper precautions against airborne particles and harmful gases when mining.
sandbox_2_iron.obtainApproach: Obtain from gathering; purchased from shop

sandbox_2_diamond.itemUsage: Professional-strength building material widely used in the construction of advanced buildings.
sandbox_2_diamond.itemDesc: A high-quality material hardly used in Constructs because of its rarity.
sandbox_2_diamond.obtainApproach: Obtain from gathering; purchased from shop

sandbox_2_crab.itemUsage: Ingredient that has a chance to drop when hunting.
sandbox_2_crab.itemDesc: Cragpincers are delicious, far more desirable than sandworms.
sandbox_2_crab.obtainApproach: Dropped by enemies; purchased from shop; from Plans

sandbox_2_wheat.obtainApproach: Produced; dropped by enemies; purchased from shop; from Plans

sandbox_2_venison.itemUsage: Ingredient that has a chance to drop when hunting.
sandbox_2_venison.itemDesc: Juicy and tender meat that goes well with many different types of ingredients.
sandbox_2_venison.obtainApproach: Dropped by enemies; purchased from shop; from Plans

sandbox_2_beef.itemUsage: Ingredient that has a chance to drop when hunting.
sandbox_2_beef.itemDesc: Leg meat attached to a big bone, with a naturally herb-like aroma.
sandbox_2_beef.obtainApproach: Dropped by enemies; purchased from shop; from Plans

sandbox_2_poultry.itemUsage: Ingredient that has a chance to drop when hunting.
sandbox_2_poultry.itemDesc: The most delicious part of a Fowlbeast.
sandbox_2_poultry.obtainApproach: Dropped by enemies; purchased from shop; from Plans

sandbox_2_supermeat.itemUsage: Rare ingredient that has a chance to drop when hunting rare beasts.
sandbox_2_supermeat.itemDesc: It is highly sought-after by premium restaurants for its silky texture and rich taste.
sandbox_2_supermeat.obtainApproach: Dropped by enemies; purchased from shop; from Plans

sandbox_2_water.itemUsage: Required for survival and development. Can be collected by deploying Crabbie Pumpies on Clear Water.
sandbox_2_water.itemDesc: Can be used as drinking water once purified, or used for facilities.
sandbox_2_water.obtainApproach: Obtain from gathering; dropped by enemies; purchased from shop; from Plans

sandbox_2_mushroom.itemDesc: A great choice to add some flavor to a dish. Just be careful of poisonous mushrooms.
sandbox_2_mushroom.obtainApproach: Dropped by enemies; purchased from shop

sandbox_2_peper.itemDesc: Chili pepper with a kick. Be careful of extra-spicy ones mixed within.
sandbox_2_peper.obtainApproach: Dropped by enemies; purchased from shop

sandbox_2_sugar.itemDesc: A plant with sweet juices, named because its use as a seasoning was pioneered by the Sarkaz.
sandbox_2_sugar.obtainApproach: Dropped by enemies; purchased from shop

sandbox_2_horn.itemUsage: A seasoning that you have a chance to find.
sandbox_2_horn.itemDesc: Just a little bit of it will add its unique aroma to the dish.
sandbox_2_horn.obtainApproach: Dropped by enemies; purchased from shop

sandbox_2_salt.itemUsage: A seasoning that you have a chance to find.
sandbox_2_salt.itemDesc: Add this condiment to your dish during cooking to make it extra tasty. Very popular among the people.
sandbox_2_salt.obtainApproach: Dropped by enemies; purchased from shop

sandbox_2_wings.itemUsage: A seasoning that you have a chance to find.
sandbox_2_wings.itemDesc: As the ecosystem recovers, some wild beasts will actively seek out a unique secretion from fowlbeast nests. And that's what this popular flavor enhancer is made from.
sandbox_2_wings.obtainApproach: Dropped by enemies; purchased from shop

sandbox_2_puree.itemUsage: A seasoning that you have a chance to find.
sandbox_2_puree.itemDesc: A drop is all you need to elevate the taste of your dish to the roof.
sandbox_2_puree.obtainApproach: Dropped by enemies; purchased from shop

sandbox_2_mud.itemUsage: A seasoning that you have a chance to find.
sandbox_2_mud.itemDesc: For Operators with a sweet tooth, seasonings as sweet as this are the best.
sandbox_2_mud.obtainApproach: Dropped by enemies; purchased from shop

sandbox_2_plank.itemUsage: Processed construct material widely used in the construction of buildings.
sandbox_2_plank.itemDesc:
Planks processed from Wood.
High in quality, smooth in any direction, with no bothersome splinters.

sandbox_2_brick.itemUsage: Processed construct material widely used in the construction of buildings.
sandbox_2_brick.itemDesc:
Slabs processed from Stone.
Even more likely to cause back injuries when moving.

sandbox_2_steel.itemUsage: Processed construct material widely used in the construction of buildings.
sandbox_2_steel.itemDesc:
Iron Plates processed from Iron Ore.
See your own distorted reflection in them.

sandbox_2_flax.itemDesc:
Harvested from flax plants.
It may look unremarkable, but it has plenty of uses.

sandbox_2_wool.itemDesc:
Wool obtained by rearing or defeating leporibeasts.
Be careful about getting kicked by unhappy leporibeasts while shearing them.
sandbox_2_wool.obtainApproach: Dropped by wild beasts; from rearing beasts; purchased from shop

sandbox_2_fur.itemDesc:
Fur obtained by rearing Mossback Beasts.
Thick, soft, and with a subtle scent of grass.
sandbox_2_fur.obtainApproach: Dropped by wild beasts; from rearing beasts; purchased from shop

sandbox_2_egg.itemDesc:
Fowlbeast Eggs obtained from rearing Fowlbeasts.
A popular food that is nutritious and easy to obtain.
sandbox_2_egg.obtainApproach: Dropped by wild beasts; from rearing beasts; purchased from shop

sandbox_2_shell.itemDesc:
Crabshell Fragment obtained from rearing Cragpincers.
Keep watch by their nests to get their freshly molted shells!
sandbox_2_shell.obtainApproach: Dropped by wild beasts; from rearing beasts; purchased from shop

sandbox_2_protein.itemUsage: Can be delivered in missions or traded.
sandbox_2_protein.itemDesc:
Concentrated Nutrients obtained from processing Fowlbeast Eggs or Flax.
Helps supplement trace elements missing from one's diet.

sandbox_2_rice.itemDesc:
Husked Rice obtained from processing Rice.
Tastes even better when steamed.

sandbox_2_fabric.itemDesc:
Cloth obtained from processing Flax.
Soft and comfortable; an excellent choice for clothing.

sandbox_2_fiber.itemDesc:
Industrial Fiber obtained from processing Wool or Fur.
Strong and tough; useful in industry.

sandbox_2_leather.itemDesc:
Waterproof Hide obtained from processing Fur or Crabshell Fragment.
Just prop one up on your head to act as an impromptu umbrella.

sandbox_2_binder.itemDesc:
Adhesive obtained from processing Crabshell Fragments, Rice or Fowlbeast Eggs.
Careful not to stick your own fingers together!

sandbox_2_tool.itemUsage: Can be delivered in missions or traded.
sandbox_2_tool.itemDesc:
Tools obtained from processing large quantities of Iron Plates and Slabs.
The use of tools sets humanity apart from beasts.

sandbox_2_rations.itemUsage: Can be delivered in missions or traded.
sandbox_2_rations.itemDesc:
Rations obtained from processing large quantities of Husked Rice and Planks.
Easy to carry around, not so easy to swallow.

sandbox_2_medkit.itemUsage: Can be delivered in missions or traded.
sandbox_2_medkit.itemDesc:
Bandages obtained from processing large quantities of Cloth and Planks.
Even the smallest scratch must be properly tended to in the field.

sandbox_2_energy.itemUsage: Can be delivered in missions or traded.
sandbox_2_energy.itemDesc:
Energy Boosters obtained from processing large quantities of Concentrated Nutrients and Fresh Water.
One bottle will keep you going for an entire day.

sandbox_2_weapon.itemUsage: Can be delivered in missions or traded.
sandbox_2_weapon.itemDesc:
Weapons obtained from processing large quantities of Industrial Fiber and Iron Plates.
Solves a lot of problems.

sandbox_2_equipment.itemUsage: Can be delivered in missions or traded.
sandbox_2_equipment.itemDesc:
Equipment obtained from processing large quantities of Slabs and Waterproof Hides.
Protects you from the wind and rain.

sandbox_2_raincoat.itemUsage: Can be delivered in missions or traded.
sandbox_2_raincoat.itemDesc:
Protective Equipment obtained from processing large quantities of Waterproof Hides and Adhesives.
Safety always comes first.

sandbox_2_exoskeleton.itemUsage: Can be delivered in missions or traded.
sandbox_2_exoskeleton.itemDesc:
Instruments obtained from processing large quantities of Adhesives and Iron Plates.
Always nice to have a helping hand or two while working—literally.

sandbox_2_wine.itemUsage: Can be delivered in missions or traded.
sandbox_2_wine.itemDesc:
Drinks obtained from processing large quantities of Rice and Fresh Water.
Chewing on the rice while drinking is part of the enjoyment.

sandbox_2_tent.itemUsage: Can be delivered in missions or traded.
sandbox_2_tent.itemDesc:
Fieldwork Items obtained from processing Flax and Planks.
Makes nights in the wilderness less unbearable.

sandbox_2_building_infrastructure_1.itemUsage: Produces <Gatherers> to gather from <Thickets>, <Monoliths>, <Strange Ore Veins> and other resources; up to 3 <Gatherers> can be produced, with a deployment limit of 5
sandbox_2_building_infrastructure_1.itemDesc: Temporary Gathering Station established to expand gathering range. Small, but very capable.

sandbox_2_building_infrastructure_2.itemUsage: Offers visibility in an area; Attack Range is considered an extension of Gathering Station range
sandbox_2_building_infrastructure_2.itemDesc: The more you build, the further you can see, making it safe to go where no one has gone before.

sandbox_2_building_infrastructure_3.itemUsage: Allows Ranged Operators to be deployed on top
sandbox_2_building_infrastructure_3.itemDesc: A very common defense structure. Place it high enough and operators atop it will gain a sufficient advantage in combat.

sandbox_2_building_infrastructure_4.itemUsage: Blocks the enemy's path, forcing them to go around it
sandbox_2_building_infrastructure_4.itemDesc:
A high-tech defensive construct that is indeed real, but is hard to see and touch.
Redefines the concept of an invisible wall.

sandbox_2_building_infrastructure_5.itemDesc: A defense construct equipped with a self-destruct device. When the construct is destroyed, the device activates and explodes.

sandbox_2_building_infrastructure_6.itemUsage: Connects to Supply Vehicle Tracks and a Terminus to launch a Supply Vehicle
sandbox_2_building_infrastructure_6.itemDesc: Developed by Engineering to ensure the smooth development of the new base. Maintenance Vehicles depart from here.

sandbox_2_building_infrastructure_7.itemUsage: When a Supply Vehicle passes through, causes Constructs and Operators within Attack Range to gain SP based on the distance traveled by Supply Vehicle
sandbox_2_building_infrastructure_7.itemDesc: Developed by Engineering to ensure the smooth development of the new base. Maintenance Vehicles provide maintenance and resupply here.

sandbox_2_building_infrastructure_8.itemUsage: When a Supply Vehicle arrives, gives SP to Constructs and Operators within Attack Range
sandbox_2_building_infrastructure_8.itemDesc: Developed by Engineering to ensure the smooth development of the new base. Maintenance Vehicles are retrieved here and provide maintenance and resupply.

sandbox_2_building_infrastructure_9.itemUsage: Supply Vehicles can follow this forward
sandbox_2_building_infrastructure_9.itemDesc: Developed by Engineering to ensure the smooth development of the new base. The more straight tracks there are, the further the Maintenance Vehicles can go.

sandbox_2_building_infrastructure_10.itemUsage: Supply Vehicles can follow this forward
sandbox_2_building_infrastructure_10.itemDesc: Developed by Engineering to ensure the smooth development of the new base. The more turns there are, the wider the Maintenance Vehicles can range.

sandbox_2_building_infrastructure_11.itemUsage: Processing Constructs within Attack Range gain SP; recovers SP when attacked by the beast placed within
sandbox_2_building_infrastructure_11.itemDesc: While looking for a way to recycle energy, the inventor was inspired by his musbeast's frenzied running on the wheel.

sandbox_2_building_infrastructure_12.itemUsage: Causes lightning within its Attack Range to strike its location

sandbox_2_building_defence_1.itemUsage: Pushes an enemy in front away
sandbox_2_building_defence_1.itemDesc:
Equipped with a can of compressed air that knocks the target back.
Does not deal damage to the target.

sandbox_2_building_defence_2.itemUsage: Fires a net at an enemy in front, binding them for a period of time
sandbox_2_building_defence_2.itemDesc:
Launcher that searches for enemies from above, firing nets that trap them.
The fire and blade-resistant nets once trapped their creator for an entire day.

sandbox_2_building_process_1.itemUsage:
[lv1] Wood → Plank
[lv1] Stone → Slab
[lv1] Iron Ore → Iron Plate
sandbox_2_building_process_1.itemDesc: Processes Stone, Wood, and Iron Ore into finished products. Basic, yet indispensable.

sandbox_2_building_process_2.itemDesc: Processes Rice into finished products. Sunvalley Industries offers free repair services during farming season.

sandbox_2_building_process_3.itemDesc: Processes Flax into finished products. A simple flax rope or a small flax seed can give unexpected energy.

sandbox_2_building_process_4.itemDesc: Processes Wool into finished products. An elderly recipient was so overjoyed that the pet cloudbeast at home got a scarf.

sandbox_2_building_process_5.itemUsage:
[lv2] Fowlbeast Egg → Concentrated Nutrients
[lv1] Fowlbeast Egg → Adhesive
Charges gauge upon taking hits
sandbox_2_building_process_5.itemDesc: Processes Fowlbeast Eggs into finished products. Fowlbeast Eggs are tasty, nutritious, and useful in industry.

sandbox_2_building_process_6.itemUsage:
[lv2] Fur → Waterproof Hide
[lv1] Fur → Industrial Fiber
Charges gauge upon taking damage; has high RES
sandbox_2_building_process_6.itemDesc: Processes Fur into finished products. The Sunvalley Liaison tells you that their uniforms are made from fabric manufactured using this processor.

sandbox_2_building_process_7.itemUsage:
[lv2] Crabshell Fragment → Adhesive
[lv1] Crabshell Fragment → Waterproof Hide
Charges gauge upon taking damage; has high DEF
sandbox_2_building_process_7.itemDesc: Processes Crabshell into finished products. Molted Cragpincer shells are sold as souvenirs in some parts.

sandbox_2_building_process_8.itemUsage:
[lv2] Husked Rice + Plank → Box of Rations
[lv1] Rice + Water → Box of Drinks
[lv1] Fowlbeast Egg → Concentrated Nutrients
sandbox_2_building_process_8.itemDesc: There is nothing more important than filling one's stomach, except for filling one's stomach with good food.

sandbox_2_building_process_9.itemUsage:
[lv3] Adhesive + Iron Plate → Box of Instruments
[lv1] Industrial Fiber + Iron Plate → Box of Weapons
Charges gauge upon taking damage; has high DEF and RES
sandbox_2_building_process_9.itemDesc: Someone once ordered a full set of equipment just to cosplay as their favorite comic book character.

sandbox_2_building_process_10.itemUsage:
[lv2] Slab + Iron Plate → Box of Tools
[lv1] Rice → Husked Rice
[lv1] Crabshell Fragment → Waterproof Hide
Charges gauge upon taking hits
sandbox_2_building_process_10.itemDesc: Make sure there is plenty of stock in the depot, and make sure musbeasts stay out of it.

sandbox_2_building_process_11.itemUsage:
[lv2] Waterproof Hide + Adhesive → Box of Protective Equipment
[lv1] Slab + Waterproof Hide → Box of Equipment
[lv1] Wool → Cloth
sandbox_2_building_process_11.itemDesc: From small to large to extra-large, there is a size here for everyone.

sandbox_2_building_process_12.itemUsage:
[lv3] Flax + Plank → Box of Fieldwork Items
[lv1] Waterproof Hide + Adhesive → Box of Protective Equipment
sandbox_2_building_process_12.itemDesc: Never go on a field mission without it.

sandbox_2_building_process_13.itemUsage:
[lv2] Plank + Cloth → Box of Bandages
[lv1] Fur → Industrial Fiber
[lv1] Concentrated Nutrients + Water→ Box of Energy Boosters
sandbox_2_building_process_13.itemDesc: Good preparation goes a long way to preventing panic.

sandbox_2_building_process_14.itemUsage:
[lv2] Industrial Fiber + Iron Plate → Box of Weapons
[lv1] Adhesive + Iron Plate → Box of Instruments
[lv1] Iron Ore → Iron Plate
Charges gauge upon taking hits
sandbox_2_building_process_14.itemDesc: Molten steel can burn away almost anything, but that does not mean you should chuck your trash into the furnace.

sandbox_2_building_process_15.itemUsage:
[lv2] Slab + Waterproof Hide → Box of Equipment
[lv1] Slab + Iron Plate → Box of Tools
[lv1] Stone → Slab
sandbox_2_building_process_15.itemDesc: A worker who lost his lunch found his sandwich flattened on the ground at the end of the shift.

sandbox_2_building_process_16.itemUsage:
[lv1] Flax + Plank → Box of Fieldwork Items
[lv1] Plank + Cloth → Box of Bandages
[lv1] Husked Rice + Plank → Box of Rations
[lv1] Wood → Plank
sandbox_2_building_process_16.itemDesc: Those with experience in wilderness survival always look at discarded wood shavings with chagrin, for they would have made excellent tinder.

sandbox_2_building_process_17.itemUsage:
[lv2] Concentrated Nutrients + Water → Box of Energy Boosters
[lv2] Rice + Water → Box of Drinks
Charges gauge upon taking hits
sandbox_2_building_process_17.itemDesc: All the drinks you could want. Every young child's dream job.

sandbox_2_building_producer_1.itemUsage: When skill is activated, all tiles within Attack Range have a chance to generate 1 <Thicket>
sandbox_2_building_producer_1.itemDesc: A resource spawner that stimulates tree growth using Originium Arts. Do not use on household potted plants. Read the manual carefully to prevent your balcony from becoming overgrown.

sandbox_2_building_producer_2.itemUsage: When skill is activated, all tiles within Attack Range have a chance to generate 1 <Monolith>
sandbox_2_building_producer_2.itemDesc: Not magic, just a resource spawner that uses high pressure and heat to stimulate rock formation.

sandbox_2_building_producer_3.itemUsage: When skill is activated, all tiles within Attack Range have a chance to generate 1 <Strange Ore Vein>
sandbox_2_building_producer_3.itemDesc: A resource spawner that uses high pressure and heat to stimulate iron ore formation. Use your resources efficiently.

sandbox_2_building_producer_4.itemUsage: Produces Rice; can be healed, and can be harvested when HP is at max
sandbox_2_building_producer_4.itemDesc: Take good care of your rice seedlings and don't let the various burden, stock, mus, cysty, cloud, or beckbeasts eat them!

sandbox_2_building_producer_5.itemUsage: Produces Flax; can be healed, and can be harvested when HP is at max
sandbox_2_building_producer_5.itemDesc: Take good care of your flax seedlings and don't let the various burden, stock, mus, cysty, cloud, or beckbeasts eat them!

sandbox_2_building_producer_6.itemUsage: Rice Planting Troughs and Flax Planting Troughs within range give 1.5x drops (stacks)
sandbox_2_building_producer_6.itemDesc: Sprays a nutrient solution that improves crop growth. Does not help you grow taller or make your hair or horns any shinier.

sandbox_2_building_producer_7.itemUsage: Collects Fresh Water from Clear Water; SP recovery increased for every Operator or Summon within Attack Range
sandbox_2_building_producer_7.itemDesc:
Highly-effective automatic pump. Just deploy it near a source of water.
The form was originally inspired by metal crabs, but was modified after wild metal crabs began seeing it as a rival.

sandbox_2_building_producer_9.itemUsage: Can draw out Cragpincers on Clear Water
sandbox_2_building_producer_9.itemDesc: Cragpincers really like the feed inside. They didn't mean to come, but couldn't resist.

sandbox_2_building_producer_10.itemUsage: Wild beasts can be reared here
sandbox_2_building_producer_10.itemDesc: Small structure where you can raise various captured wild beasts.

sandbox_2_building_producer_11.itemUsage: Lures wild beasts within Attack Range
sandbox_2_building_producer_11.itemDesc: Wild beasts are always curious about things they have never seen before.

sandbox_2_building_producer_12.itemUsage: Large beasts and wild beasts can be reared here
sandbox_2_building_producer_12.itemDesc: Large structure where you can raise various captured wild beasts.

sandbox_2_building_aesthetics_1.itemUsage: This tile is considered water terrain; other Constructs within Attack Range have 1.2x Appeal (stacks); gain 5 Crude Gold when skill is activated
sandbox_2_building_aesthetics_1.itemDesc: Water splashes, moistening the air. Standing next to it, you can feel a breath of coolness.

sandbox_2_building_aesthetics_2.itemUsage: SP recovery +0.4/s when there are resources (Thickets, etc.) in the 4 adjacent tiles; gain 2-12 Crude Gold at random when skill is activated
sandbox_2_building_aesthetics_2.itemDesc: Bold fowlbeasts often wash their feathers here.

sandbox_2_building_aesthetics_3.itemUsage: SP recovery +0.4/s when there is high ground, water terrain, or Bushes in the 4 adjacent tiles; gain 3 Crude Gold when skill is activated
sandbox_2_building_aesthetics_3.itemDesc: One of the most popular outdoor facilities. People often rest up on top to enjoy a rare moment of leisure.

sandbox_2_building_aesthetics_4.itemUsage: Production Facilities and Decorations within range have +10 Appeal; gain 24 Crude Gold when skill is activated
sandbox_2_building_aesthetics_4.itemDesc: Some things always fly high in the wind.

sandbox_2_building_service_1.itemUsage: Maintains high Prosperity and buffs when Energy Boosters or Drinks are spent
sandbox_2_building_service_1.itemDesc: The Procurement Department works hard to supply everyone's favorite drinks.

sandbox_2_building_service_2.itemUsage: Maintains high Prosperity and buffs when Rations, Energy Boosters or Drinks are spent
sandbox_2_building_service_2.itemDesc: The Procurement Department works hard to supply everyone's favorite foods.

sandbox_2_building_service_3.itemUsage: Maintains high Prosperity and buffs when Bandages or Energy Boosters are spent
sandbox_2_building_service_3.itemDesc: Established at the request of the Medical Department.

sandbox_2_building_service_4.itemUsage: Maintains high Prosperity and buffs when Tools or Weapons are spent
sandbox_2_building_service_4.itemDesc: The Engineering Department is very satisfied with the equipment on offer.

sandbox_2_building_service_5.itemUsage: Maintains high Prosperity and buffs when Equipment or Weapons are spent
sandbox_2_building_service_5.itemDesc: Field operators come here to pick their preferred equipment before setting out on a mission.

sandbox_2_tactical_1.itemUsage: Allows Operators to be deployed on water terrain
sandbox_2_tactical_1.itemDesc: Item discovered in the wastelands. Constructs a platform on the water upon which any unit can be deployed.

sandbox_2_tactical_2.itemUsage: Stuns all enemies in the four adjacent tiles for a period of time
sandbox_2_tactical_2.itemDesc: Item discovered in the wastelands, able to stun the enemy.

sandbox_2_tactical_3.itemUsage: Inflicts Sleep on enemies in the 8 surrounding tiles for a period of time; special effect on beasts
sandbox_2_tactical_3.itemDesc:
Originally used by hunters to put wild animals to sleep.
It has found use as a sleeping aid as well, though proper dosage must be observed.

sandbox_2_tactical_4.itemUsage: Can be deployed on high and low ground. All friendly units in the surrounding 8 tiles gain Camouflage and are immune to Stun
sandbox_2_tactical_4.itemDesc:
Sunvalley Industries equipment developed to investigate Acidic Originium Slug habitats, camouflaging the user while providing defensive support.
It will at least help you keep your clothes on in a corrosive environment.

sandbox_2_tactical_5.itemUsage: Periodically grants Barrier to a friendly unit
sandbox_2_tactical_5.itemDesc:
A portable shield generator.
It has been modified to automatically provide protection without manual command.

sandbox_2_tactical_6.itemUsage: Applies Frozen for a period of time to enemies within range
sandbox_2_tactical_6.itemDesc:
A wonderful can filled with artificial ice and snow.
They used to use cans like these to create snow in films, until the day a certain prop master overstuffed one...

sandbox_2_tactical_7.itemUsage: Immediately retreats the Operator in front and greatly reduces their Redeployment Time
sandbox_2_tactical_7.itemDesc: Item discovered in the wastelands, enabling quick movement of Operators.

sandbox_2_tactical_8.itemUsage: Periodically restores SP to a friendly unit
sandbox_2_tactical_8.itemDesc: Item discovered in the wastelands, able to restore Operator SP.

sandbox_2_tactical_9.itemUsage: Explodes to deal heavy True damage to all enemies within range
sandbox_2_tactical_9.itemDesc: Item discovered in the wastelands, capable of dealing heavy damage and destroying Dirt Mounds.

sandbox_2_tactical_10.itemUsage: Captures wild beasts with HP below 50% when skill is activated
sandbox_2_tactical_10.itemDesc:
A special metal trap that can withstand a wasteland beast's every attack. 
Place it in a place where beasts roam, open the trap, leave bait, and wait a while and you'll get a pretty good catch.

sandbox_2_tactical_11.itemUsage: Captures a wild beast within Attack Range
sandbox_2_tactical_11.itemDesc:
A special metal trap that can withstand a wasteland beast's every attack. 
Place it in a place where beasts roam, open the trap, leave bait, and wait a while and you'll get a pretty good catch.

sandbox_2_tactical_12.itemUsage: Prevents the Operator in front from being defeated, but forces them to retreat after some time and increases their Redeployment Time
sandbox_2_tactical_12.itemDesc:
A stimulant that fills you to the brim with temporary strength.
Widely used on the battlefield, but currently a topic of debate on whether that should continue.

sandbox_2_recipe_infrastructure_1.itemUsage: Unlocks [Temporary Gathering Station]: Deploys <Gatherers> to gather resources within range
sandbox_2_recipe_infrastructure_1.itemDesc: Temporary Gathering Station established to expand gathering range. Small, but very capable.
sandbox_2_recipe_infrastructure_1.obtainApproach: Purchased from shop; issued as a reward

sandbox_2_recipe_infrastructure_2.itemUsage: Unlocks [Communications Base Station]: Offers visibility in an area; Attack Range is considered an extension of Gathering Station range
sandbox_2_recipe_infrastructure_2.itemDesc: The more you build, the further you can see, making it safe to go where no one has gone before.
sandbox_2_recipe_infrastructure_2.obtainApproach: Purchased from shop; issued as a reward

sandbox_2_recipe_infrastructure_3.itemUsage: Unlocks [Battlement]: Allows Ranged Operators to be deployed on top

sandbox_2_recipe_infrastructure_3.obtainApproach: Purchased from shop; issued as a reward

sandbox_2_recipe_infrastructure_4.itemUsage: Unlocks [Phantomic Barrier]: Blocks the enemy's path, forcing them to go around it

A high-tech defensive construct that is indeed real, but is hard to see and touch.

sandbox_2_recipe_infrastructure_10.obtainApproach: Purchased from shop; issued as a reward

sandbox_2_recipe_infrastructure_11.obtainApproach: Purchased from shop; issued as a reward

sandbox_2_recipe_infrastructure_12.itemUsage: Unlocks [Lightning Rod]: Causes lightning within its Attack Range to strike its location
sandbox_2_recipe_infrastructure_12.obtainApproach: Purchased from shop; issued as a reward

Equipped with a can of compressed air that knocks the target back.

sandbox_2_recipe_defence_1.obtainApproach: Purchased from shop; issued as a reward

Launcher that searches for enemies from above, firing nets that trap them.

sandbox_2_recipe_defence_2.obtainApproach: Purchased from shop; issued as a reward

sandbox_2_food_1.itemUsage:
Can be cooked at the food cart during the Rest Phase.
Skill SP cost -20%.
sandbox_2_food_1.itemDesc:
The color alone excites the mind and arouses the desire to have it, turning heads even if one has already passed it by.
A single sip fills you with energy. It has been in high demand due to rumors that the Radiant Knight drinks it.

sandbox_2_food_2.itemUsage:
Can be cooked at the food cart during the Rest Phase.
+5 ASPD every time a skill is used, stacking up to 6 times.
sandbox_2_food_2.itemDesc:
Comprised of protein, fat, and carbohydrates according to the needs of the human body. Easy to make and carry.
Often carried by explorers.

sandbox_2_food_3.itemUsage:
Can be cooked at the food cart during the Rest Phase.
Block +1; sends any carried resources to the Depot when skill expires.
sandbox_2_food_3.itemDesc:
The pure appearance is soothing, but the flavor creates strange mental images... of explosions?
And why is it so damn sweet?

sandbox_2_food_4.itemUsage:
Can be cooked at the food cart during the Rest Phase.
ATK increases with distance from target (including Constructs, max 130% of ATK).
sandbox_2_food_4.itemDesc:
A simple mix of smoked river fin and fresh fruits. 
To nomadic city dwellers, they're both expensive ingredients.

sandbox_2_food_5.itemUsage:
Can be cooked at the food cart during the Rest Phase.
For every Operator who ate this food, all Operators who ate it gain +10% ATK.
sandbox_2_food_5.itemDesc:
Food granules made with an appealing appearance to make the eater happy.
People trying to satiate their hunger and quickly get their energy boost, however, seldom notice.

sandbox_2_food_6.itemUsage:
Can be cooked at the food cart during the Rest Phase.
Reduces next Redeployment Time by -15% per resource carried (max 60%).
sandbox_2_food_6.itemDesc:
Every country has its own ways of dining, and one is free to mix and match.
One would be well-advised not to try to put xiaolongbaos in wraps, or risk starting a riot.

sandbox_2_food_7.itemUsage:
Can be cooked at the food cart during the Rest Phase.
Redeployment Time -20%.
sandbox_2_food_7.itemDesc:
Made with fresh seasonal produce, delivering a treat for the eyes and conveying Zen through plating.
Higashinese chefs believe in achieving the best of both worlds in taste and appearance.

sandbox_2_food_8.itemUsage:
Can be cooked at the food cart during the Rest Phase.
-50 ASPD and +100% ATK.
sandbox_2_food_8.itemDesc:
A liquid extract of eggs marinated in pepper, minced meat, and wine. A portable version of a local favorite.
Traditionally cooked via exposure to direct sunlight, so many nomadic city stores have professional sunlight directing equipment to recreate the technique.

sandbox_2_food_9.itemUsage:
Can be cooked at the food cart during the Rest Phase.
+1 Block for each Construct in the 4 adjacent tiles.
sandbox_2_food_9.itemDesc:
All it takes is a few cuts and a quick rinse.
A controversial dish. Some claim to feel like they grew a shell like a cragpincer after eating it, which may or may not be an allergic reaction.

sandbox_2_food_10.itemUsage:
Can be cooked at the food cart during the Rest Phase.
Reduces next Redeployment Time by -15% per enemy killed (max 60%).
sandbox_2_food_10.itemDesc: The meat has been smoked to give it a rich pine aroma. Put a few slices on hot, steaming rice, and the scent of smoked meat fills the whole room.

sandbox_2_food_11.itemUsage:
Can be cooked at the food cart during the Rest Phase.
On skill activation, other Operators that have eaten this food recover 3 SP.
sandbox_2_food_11.itemDesc:
Legend has it that a priest invented it after being inspired by an epic poem, in order to communicate what he felt.
Wait, there's alcohol in it! I'm getting dizzy already!

sandbox_2_food_12.itemUsage:
Can be cooked at the food cart during the Rest Phase.
More likely to be attacked; gains +40% Physical and Arts Dodge.
sandbox_2_food_12.itemDesc:
An esterase extracted by cooking meat with musical Originium Arts.
Handling food with Arts is a feasible method during emergencies, but the ever-evolving Leithanians have turned the cooking process into a performance.

sandbox_2_food_13.itemUsage:
Can be cooked at the food cart during the Rest Phase.
Inflicts 6s of Stun and 20% Fragile when dealing damage to a wild beast for the first time.
sandbox_2_food_13.itemDesc:
A dish passed down by Columbian mercenaries with a particularly crude process: fowlbeast meat is stuffed into a pile of 'safe' Originium and roasted within.
It tastes subtle at first, but the fowlbeast flavor lingers on your tongue for a long time after.

sandbox_2_food_14.itemUsage:
Can be cooked at the food cart during the Rest Phase.
Friendly units receive 20% more healing when in Attack Range.
sandbox_2_food_14.itemDesc: Legend has it that they serve this at Victorian state banquets. Generous meat portions are chosen, marinated, and cured in a special tower. Different parts are handled separately and grilled with oil multiple times, but there's never a burnt taste to it. Rare to find.

sandbox_2_food_15.itemUsage:
Can be cooked at the food cart during the Rest Phase.
DEF +25%, ATK +25%, takes 25% less damage from enemies blocked by this unit.
sandbox_2_food_15.itemDesc:
Machine-cooled as soon as it has been cooked, offering a wonderful texture that is frozen on the outside but still warm on the inside.
Can also be enjoyed without cooling.

sandbox_2_food_16.itemUsage:
Can be cooked at the food cart during the Rest Phase.
Gains Camouflage, ATK +50%.
sandbox_2_food_16.itemDesc: Dancing around a fire with a whole animal roasted over it as its skin becomes golden crispy and the fat seeps out of it. This is the highest honor given to guests of the jungle clans. Finish the entire dish, and you will be the clan's hero for the day!

sandbox_2_food_17.itemUsage:
Can be cooked at the food cart during the Rest Phase.
Operator gains 1 SP every 6 seconds, but automatically activates skill.
sandbox_2_food_17.itemDesc:
A gift from fate after many failed cooking attempts.
It can bring you to another land where time goes slow or fast, and perhaps with or without feelings.

sandbox_2_food_18.itemUsage:
Can be cooked at the food cart during the Rest Phase.
+10% ATK for every resource in Attack Range.
sandbox_2_food_18.itemDesc:
The Essence of Savor was invented by a chef who had lost his sense of taste. His secret joy was observing his customers' smiles to determine whether they enjoyed his food.
A heartwarming story to everyone except his apprentices, who have to taste-taste his new creations.

sandbox_2_food_19.itemUsage:
Can be cooked at the food cart during the Rest Phase.
Attacks automatically capture wild beasts with HP below 30%.
sandbox_2_food_19.itemDesc: Highly concentrated essence of the flavor and nutrition of meat. Do not directly consume this concentrated solution, even if you live near a hospital.

sandbox_2_food_20.itemUsage:
Can be cooked at the food cart during the Rest Phase.
ATK +35%; when dealing Physical damage, deals extra True damage equal to 2% of ATK.
sandbox_2_food_20.itemDesc:
A dream in the cloudy mountains.
Tea, wine, wind, snow—you can taste it all.

sandbox_2_food_21.itemUsage:
Can be cooked at the food cart during the Rest Phase.
Gains 5 SP on deployment; when skill is activated, other Operators that ate this food will also activate their skills if ready.
sandbox_2_food_21.itemDesc:
Logistics has prepared rations made from rice and puffball tenderloin to ensure operators don't go hungry during the construction of New Rhodes Island.
The taste? Come on, be more grateful that you get to eat at all at a time like this.

sandbox_2_base_cleaner.itemDesc:
A powerful cleaning machine developed by Engineering.
Metalfowl Cleaners offer an efficient way to get around, but if Engineering catches you, you will end up as one of Mechanist's assistants, or Closure's prototype testers.

sandbox_2_building_base_pdline_1.itemDesc: The heart of Rhodes Island's Energy Production System. Closure considered selling tickets to showcase this masterpiece of hers, but the plan fell through.

sandbox_2_building_base_pdline_2.itemDesc: The heart of Rhodes Island's Energy Production System. Closure considered selling tickets to showcase this masterpiece of hers, but the plan fell through.

sandbox_2_building_base_pdline_3.itemUsage: Transforms Energy into Build Parts and Build Devices
sandbox_2_building_base_pdline_3.itemDesc: The heart of Rhodes Island's Energy Production System. Closure considered selling tickets to showcase this masterpiece of hers, but the plan fell through.
